Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following

Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): By RITES Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: By Railway LAB 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Firms should submit the following documents along with offer. 1. Past Experience of same/similar items, CRAC, Receipted Challan, CRN only acceptable. 2. Past Performance. 3. Bidder Turnover Certificate and for last 3 financial years. 4. Other than OEM should submit bid specific authorization from OEM . Firms should submit the following documents along with supply of materials otherwise materials w ill be rejected. 1. Type Test Certificate Conforming to IS:7098 Part-1 from NABL Accredited lab has to be submitted along with the offer and along with the supply of material for similar type of cable having conduct or cross-sectional area not less than the mentioned size in description. The type test must include the C2 Category tests for improved fire performance. The type test report should not be older than the 5 years from the tender closing date. 2. Routine test Certificate has to be Submitted along with Supply of materials. 3. Acceptance test as per IS:7098 Part-1 has to be conducted by Inspection Agency. Additionally, the following specific steps shall be strictly adhered to during the inspection: a) Measurement of Conductor resistance on complete Lot and to be carried out on offered drum/coil length of cable. b) For length verification, rewinding of drums would be carried out on sample d rums selected as per the sampling plan mentioned in IS: 7098 (Part-1)/2025. c) Checking of sequential meter marking, provided on outer sheath of cable an d verification of meter length by calibrated steel scale /tape and inspection of homogeneity of size and shape throughout the cable length. d) In addition to hologram sealing, Polycarbonate/lead seal on the end of cable for sealing of lot. e) Sampling rate shall be doubled for all tests as and when there is any rejecti on of a firm in acceptance test .Normal inspection will be resumed when at l east 3 lots there after pass successfully. f) To ensure uniformity in construction, at least one sample shall be taken fro m in between 30% to 70% of the offered length from a randomly selected dr um, and all acceptance tests shall be carried out on the sample selected fro m this 30% to 70% range of the cable length. The Acceptance Test Report h as to be submitted along with supply of material. 4. Firm shall submit Valid BIS License Certificate for the offered product conforming to IS 7098 (Part 1) along with the offer. BIS license must cover the required cable in respect of no. of cores, core si ze & C2 category of improved fire performance.

5. Inspection agency shall verify the purchase details & test certificates of raw materials used in Cabl e viz. XLPE insulation compound, conductor, armour material and PVC sheath compound. 6. Railway may, after delivery, send samples of the supplied cable to a laboratory for testing; any ca ble found not conforming to the requirements shall be rejected at the supplier's cost. 7. Measurement of conductor resistance on complete Lot and to be carried out on offered drum/coil l ength of cable. 8. For length verification, rewinding of drums would be carried out on sample drums selected as per the sampling plan mentioned in IS:7098 (Part-1)/2025. 9. Checking the sequential meter marking, provided on outer sheath of cable and verification of met er length by calibrated steel scale/tape and inspection of homogeneity of size and shape througho ut the cable length. 10. In addition to hologram sealing, polycarbonate/lead seal on the end of cable of sealing of lot. 11. Sampling rate shall be doubled for all tests as and when there is any rejection of a firm in accepta nce test. Normal inspection will be resumed when at least 3 lots there after pass successfully. 12. Firm to submit test certificate from Govt. approved lab. 13. ISI mark, CML No, firms name and Year of manufacturing should be screen printed/embossed thro ughout the length with 1 meter interval. 14. After receipt material will be tested at Railway LAB 15. Only 500/1000 mtrs. wooden drum will be acceptable including tolerance +/-5% in drum length a nd total quantity. 16. If offer value is more than 5,00,000/-, then Inspection should be from RITES otherwise consignee i nspection applicable if offer value is less than 5,00,000/-. 17. Warranty Period : 30 months from the date of supply. .
